title: File:Amazing Hi-Def CME (full disk) - Flickr - NASA Goddard Photo and Video.jpg
author: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA
description: A beautiful prominence eruption shot off the east limb (left side) of the sun on Monday, April 16, 2012. Such eruptions are often associated with solar flares, and in this case an M1 class (medium-sized) flare did occur at the same time, though it was not aimed toward Earth. This event, which is still in progress, was seen by NASA’s SDO satellite. Credit: NASA/GSFC/SDO NASA image use policy.
